title: Havalaea Native Fauna & Time-of-Troubles Ecology

lineage_origin_model.scope: Havalaea ecological lineage/origin classification independent of current geographic presence, cultural identity, personhood, domestication and relationship state
lineage_origin_model.time_of_troubles_native_lineage_definiti: Owner-approved ecological lineage class for Havalaea-born fauna descended from lineages established through the Time of Troubles rather than later-imported animal lineages. Specific creature assignment still requires explicit source, owner or governed stable-ID authority.
lineage_origin_model.later_imported_lineage_definition: A lineage whose relevant Havalaea ancestry begins with later import/introduction rather than the owner-defined Time-of-Troubles native lineage; descendants remain distinguishable even when born on Havalaea.
lineage_origin_model.relocated_returned_or_reintroduced_linea: A lineage with explicit relocation away from or return/reintroduction to Havalaea. Return or reintroduction does not by itself determine Time-of-Troubles ancestry.
lineage_origin_model.warden_bred_or_engineered_lineage_defini: A lineage explicitly bred, engineered, seeded or ecologically managed by Green Warden or related authority. Engineering or long residence does not itself establish Time-of-Troubles native descent.
lineage_origin_model.rift_displaced_hybridized_or_conceptual_: A lineage or occurrence explicitly described as non-native, displaced, hybridized or partially conceptual through Riftfall/convergence phenomena.

canonical_havalaea_definition_coverage.reason: CEW-05 establishes Havalaea setting presence for these five stable IDs but explicitly leaves native status unknown. CEW-01/07 prohibit name-only source binding, so CEW-10 preserves lineage as unknown until explicit source, owner or governed stable-ID authority is available.

sapient_animal_integration.template_native_wording_scope: playable/sapient-animal conversion character identity and culture

boundaries: CEW-10 defines Havalaea lineage/origin semantics without auto-binding current canonical stable IDs.
Owner-approved Time-of-Troubles native lineage remains distinguishable from later imported lineages even when later descendants are born on Havalaea.
Cultural nativeness, current presence, habitat fit, wildness, ferality, Warden engineering, return or reintroduction do not silently become Time-of-Troubles native descent.
Human-level native Havalaean animals retain animal ecological identity and may project through the NPC system when source or owner authority supports the person-level classification.
NPC projection does not create humanoid identity, ownership, tamability, obedience or reduced autonomy.
Mount, pet/companion, familiar and related relationship pathways remain CEW-11-owned.
No Multiversal-app runtime, schema, UI, migration, canonical Creature Definition population or live relationship-state mutation is authorized.
